scope: One owner-authored RF2Ship0.18 baseline snapshot, the actual peer policy fix, local guest acceptance/loss controllers and necessary references only
snapshotAdmission: Only regular files explicitly listed by snapshot/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json, mapped from the RF2Ship0.18 prefix to this single original directory; guards.flow has its separate listed identity
excluded: all raw artifacts and provider responses
all VM/SSH/deployment/provisioning scripts from the active source tree
all credential files and generated keys
all native binaries, object files, guest images and caches
productChange: Client.call checks unsafe-operation TimeoutError before considering even the first retry; unknown mutation outcomes are surfaced rather than silently replayed
fixtureCorrection: Exact one-frame neighbor renewal, admitted only after captured guest clock proves pre-resolved neighbor expired; unrelated or premature ARP is refused; exact TCP/state assertions remain
